title: Develop: FTUE (First Time User Experience) Wednesday
description: A relaxed and informal roundtable designed to help you get the most out of your time at the conference. A diverse panel of friendly and experienced devs from across the whole industry spectrum want to help anyone who feels shy, awkward, a little out of place, on the outside, or just unable to really squeeze all the goodness out of this amazing show.
session_takeaway: Shared experiences that will give you some ideas on best practice plus do's and don'ts for networking.
Recommendations for talks to attend and delegates to meet, plus practical help to do so!
Knowledge of safe and quiet spaces to help manage your experience at the show.
